Title: 10 Built In Wardrobe Ideas With Real Measurements
Description: Built in wardrobe ideas with the measurements that make them work: a floor-to-ceiling run of cream shaker doors, sage alcove wardrobes either side of a chimney breast, long and double hanging rails, low storage under the eaves, sliding doors for a small bedroom and drawers with shelves for folded jumpers. The guide gives rail heights, wardrobe depth for hinged and sliding doors, how to measure an alcove and what fitted wardrobes cost in the UK in 2026.
Keywords: built in wardrobe ideas, fitted wardrobe ideas, alcove wardrobe, bedroom storage

Title: 10 Fitted Wardrobe Ideas for Small Bedrooms
Description: Fitted wardrobe ideas for small bedrooms: sliding doors that need no swing space, drawers and shelves in a shallow alcove, storage built into the eaves of a loft room, a wall-to-wall run with shaker doors, double hanging rails for shirts and trousers, and sage alcove wardrobes beside a chimney breast. Each idea comes with a real measurement, plus a diagram of rail and shelf heights and 2026 UK costs.
Keywords: fitted wardrobe ideas, small bedroom storage, built in wardrobe ideas, sliding wardrobe doors
